Subject: Re: Photo Tagging in Dropbox

Hi [Name],

This is a great initiative, I agree having a consistent tagging system will make a huge difference in how quickly we can actually use these photos.

I took a look at the document and will test it out using images from a recent event to see how it flows in practice. I’ll also keep an eye on where things feel unclear or where the taxonomy might need to be simplified or expanded.

One thing I’m already running into is that for a portion of the photos in Dropbox, I’m not always able to tell where they were taken or which initiative, meeting, or event they belong to. For the ones I’ve personally been part of or recognize, tagging should be pretty straightforward. But for others, I’ll likely need some input from the team or whoever originally captured or uploaded them to make sure we’re tagging them accurately.

It might be helpful to build in a quick step or system for identifying unknown images, whether that’s a shared reference doc, folder notes, or a quick team check-in process, especially before we go back and tag older photos.

I’ll start testing this out and report back with any suggestions or adjustments once I’ve worked through a batch.

Thanks again for putting this together, this will be a really valuable system once it’s dialed in.

Best,  
Bethany
